item.title: A Hezbollah commander describes battling Israel in Lebanon
item.summary: In a rare interview, a wounded Hezbollah commander tells NPR about his secretive Shia Muslim militia's new command structure and how it has managed to keep firing rockets into northern Israel.

item.title: The U.S. military says it will blockade Iranian ports as Iran peace talks collapse
item.summary: After talks between the U.S. and Iran collapsed, President Trump said the U.S. will "blockade" the Strait of Hormuz. The U.S. military said it would blockade ships entering or exiting Iranian ports.

item.title: White House ballroom construction can continue for now, appeals court says
item.summary: The order comes as the Trump administration challenges a lower court ruling that the estimated $300-million project requires congressional approval.

item.title: Hungary's Viktor Orbán concedes defeat, ending 16 years in power
item.summary: Hungarian voters turned out in the greatest numbers since the 1990s to turn away from Prime Minister Viktor Orbán's right-wing populist Fidesz party.

item.title: A country-by-country glance at Pope Leo XIV's trip to Africa
item.summary: Pope Leo XIV's four-nation, 11-day trip to Africa is so dizzying in its complexity it recalls some of the globetrotting odysseys of St. John Paul II in his early years.

item.title: Sunday Puzzle: Sweet Treat
item.summary: NPR's Ayesha Rascoe plays the puzzle with KUT listener Nell Newton and Weekend Edition Puzzlemaster Will Shortz.

item.title: Fighting assault allegations, Eric Swalwell suspends his bid for California governor
item.summary: The San Francisco Chronicle and CNN reported multiple allegations of sexual assault and misconduct. Swalwell calls them false but apologized to his supporters and family.

item.title: Asha Bhosle, the voice of Bollywood, has died aged 92
item.summary: The Bollywood legend was one of the world's most recorded artists — who, by her own reckoning, made more than 12,000 songs.

item.title: Why your favorite artists keep pairing up for co-headlining tours
item.summary: From SZA and Kendrick Lamar, to MJ Lenderman and Waxahatchee, there's been an uptick in recent years of prominent artists joining forces for a co-headlining tour.

item.title: The real space science behind 'Project Hail Mary'
item.summary: The science fiction blockbuster wowed audiences with its depiction of space travel and more. Here's what NASA staff and other scientists say about the basis for the amazing events of the film.
